summary: Fresh independent verification passes AC1-AC12 on the current repository state. Unit, lint, production static build, complete and isolated Playwright, static visual proof, full WebP decode, hash/size, output, JSON, repository proof, and deadline-carl gates all exit 0. Independent inspection of the four regenerated contact sheets, representative original-resolution assets, contract viewport captures, route/ending frames, and save/combat frames finds no release-blocking visual defect. No non-PASS criterion exists, so problems.md is not required.

criteria.reason: The typed production contract and fresh static/runtime checks enumerate 56 formal assets across character, CG, UI, and effect categories. Files resolve and decode, hashes are unique, character and CG matrices have zero missing keys, browser requests succeed, and forbidden-pattern candidates are confined to non-formal fallbacks, legacy CSS, negative tests, screenshot capture code, and SVG MIME handling.

Fresh public-UI coverage records all 30 expected character-state keys with 30 visible entries and no missing key. Independent review of the 30-cell sheet and representative originals confirms recognizable identities, distinct state semantics, usable transparency, consistent costumes and silhouettes, and no release-blocking watermark, text, anatomy, crop, or identity defect.

Fresh production E2E reaches the seven required scene CGs and nine ending CGs through public UI, with 16/16 runtime entries and no missing key. The 16-cell sheet and captured pages show distinct, narratively readable, consistently styled compositions without stretch or decisive text, watermark, modern-object, or relationship contradiction.

Three unique formal UI artworks render for main menu, settings, and saves at all four contract viewports. Fresh assertions pass reachability, overflow, settings-group separation, bounded scrolling, fixed-header hit testing, focus behavior, and retained content; inspected captures keep controls readable and preserve the tomb, gu, ink, bronze, and blood-red visual language.

Fresh browser runs cover six player bitmap effects followed by the enemy effect, continued turns, request-abort fallback, and reduced motion. Captured effects are distinct and directionally readable above the stage while dialogue and controls remain legible; the automated timing, ordering, layer, pointer-event, recovery, and reduced-motion assertions pass.

art-generation.json contains 56 records, 56 adopted ImageGen calls with unique output IDs, complete prompts, allowed post-processing, inspection metadata, and 56 retained originals. Independent inspection of all four contact sheets and representative full-size character, CG, UI, and effect files finds coherent semi-realistic dark Chinese-fantasy art without a release-blocking watermark, generated text, brand mark, anatomy, alpha, or narrative defect.

ImageMagick freshly decodes all 64 release WebPs. The formal audit passes 56 unique hashes and 5,165,122 total bytes with all class thresholds satisfied; the broader four-directory audit finds zero duplicate SHA-256 groups. Fresh homepage evidence records one image request and 33,040 transferred bytes, far below the frozen limits, with no eager matrix preload.

Fresh production suites pass deterministic coverage at 1366x768, 1920x1080, 844x390, and 390x844, including no global overflow, mobile rotation prompt, settings scroll reachability and hit testing, keyboard focus, and reduced motion. Independent capture review finds no clipped primary control, unsafe overlap, visible stretch, or release-blocking obstruction.

The fresh 16-test production suite passes all four formal routes, seven required nodes, and nine endings through public UI against the newly built out/ export. Runtime reports contain 30/30 character and 16/16 CG entries with no missing key, while captured pages identify the active node or ending together with its mapped formal art.

Fresh unit and production browser coverage passes six-slot manual save/load behavior, quick save/load, return-to-menu reload, version-6 missing-visual-metadata compatibility, scene and battle restoration, all required actions and effects, request degradation, reduced motion, and victory/failure flows without changing frozen save or combat semantics.

All current-state gates pass without skips: pnpm test 98/98, pnpm lint, pnpm build with a fresh out/index.html, pnpm test:e2e:run 16/16, isolated visual-art Playwright 5/5, and proof:visual:static for 56 unique formal assets and four contact sheets.

evidence.json parses, every fixed proof path is present, required raw matrices, screenshots, contact sheets, fixture, checkpoints, and manual review exist, and production code has not changed since the reviewed 840d8ad implementation commit. scripts/validate-task-proof.mjs reports PASS and deadline-carl reports valid=true with no missing file or schema error.
